new_candidates.body: ### Question Hello there, I followed the [tutorial](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/v3.0.0-EA/source/setup/tutorial.html) instructions, and there was no issue. Now, I am trying to add a custom USD asset below to the starter file. Below are the parameters for displaying a belt texture from IsaacSim 6.2.0 I added the following code to the tutorial code. ``` table = AssetBaseCfg( prim_path="{ENV_REGEX_NS}/Table", spawn=sim_utils.UsdFileCfg( usd_path="/home/kimbring2/IsaacLabTutorial/src/isaaclab_tutorial/assets/Collected_SES_V2_LSS_5DOF/SES_V2_LSS_CASE.usd", ), init_state=AssetBaseCfg.InitialStateCfg(pos=(-1.0, -1.0, 0.26854), #rot=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ), ) ``` However, it is displayed as a broken asset in the following image. I assume that **Raw USD Properties** are ignored when I render it from the Newton visualizer. I tried to use the Kit visualizer for the tutorial project using the command below, but failed with error below. uv run isaaclab zero_agent --task IsaacTutorial-Place-Vial-SO101 --num_envs 1 --visualizer kit Could you please explain how to run a tutorial project in the IsaacSim visualizer, or how to correctly apply raw USD properties within the Newton visualizer? Thank you. ### Build Info Describe the versions that you are currently using: - Isaac Lab Version: 3.0.0 release - Isaac Sim Version: 6.2
